primaryConclusion: The new own-model pipeline learns role/end structure and very generic grammatical Japanese at both widths, but this is an early severely undertrained pilot, not evidence of natural context-appropriate daily dialogue. Larger width lowers body prediction loss at the same small data exposure, while neither model generates content-specific replies and selfplay stalls. Neither model should be adopted; do not infer a broad capacity ceiling or a failed overall data strategy from0.1476epoch.

selfplay.limitation: Forced3turn humanA/B stress, not interactive human evaluation, and not proof of infinite loops. Full source histories remain visible. Single acknowledgment naturalness is not context comprehension.

interpretation.roleEndVersusLanguage: Role top1~97.6/98.4percent and EOS top1~97.3/97.2percent are learned far more strongly than body top1~5.38/7.01percent. Overall target loss/accuracy combine these easy structural targets, so report body separately. Correct termination does not imply a meaningful answer.
interpretation.sizeComparison: Medium bodyNLL5.757 versus6.007 small and byteNLL1.0595 versus1.1096 show a prediction advantage under this fixed512-update regime. Specific-content generation remains0/32 in each. This is not a demonstrated conversation-ability improvement and not enough to pick a production model size.
interpretation.whyNotCapacityRejection: Both models see415321targets of which361960body tokens,2048distinct windows~14.76percent of one epoch. Targets-per-parameter only~0.0949/small and~0.0370/medium. A wider randomly initialized model is not expected to exhibit its eventual ability from an equal tiny token budget; prior FFN findings and64-pair memorization do not settle broad capacity.
interpretation.singleSeedAndDropout: The same window IDs, target dose, sampler and hyperparameters are controlled. Width-dependent parameter/dropout shapes do not produce identical Torch random histories; one seed is descriptive. Within-model disk restart is exact.
interpretation.contextClaims: Nearly all outputs are generic acknowledgments independent of content; this fails content-bearing questions. It does not identify a particular attention layer as broken or prove zero conditional context information in teacher-forced logits.
interpretation.tokenizerAndNumerics: Fresh TRAIN-only own BPE and speaker-held split are substantial validity improvements. No present evidence isolates tokenizer or numerical error as the cause of universal acknowledgments. Parent reports6prefix<=4token parity argmax0/max~3.8e-6; that is limited implementation evidence, not full192-token global parity.
interpretation.legacyComparison: R46 byteNLL~0.7539 on the shared gold bytes is lower descriptively, but R46 saw these documents as original TRAIN and uses different tokenizer/plain-format/longer training history. New held is unseen for fresh models, not for R46. No fair unseen-capability ranking or raw token-NLL comparison against R46 follows.
interpretation.goalStatus: Natural grammatical short utterances and end markers alone are insufficient. Content-specific answers, context adaptation and meaningful multi-turn behavior remain unmet. No threshold relaxation, answer repair, repetition suppression or memorized answer mechanism is warranted.

priorityOrder.topic: Sufficient measured learning coverage and broader human-language foundation
priorityOrder.reason: 85percent of this admitted training-window epoch has not yet been consumed. A very early learning-curve milestone is more informative than another loss coefficient or architecture change. Main program must include diverse modern human prose plus authentic conversations, not a single source of short chat.

priorityOrder.topic: Licensed source diversity and quality before large-scale corpus repetition
priorityOrder.reason: Current new TRAIN has~2.823m tokens in the resource plan. Repeating it79.5times to reach illustrative20N for11.2m is not79.5times new knowledge. Acquire/audit independent modern Japanese prose and conversational genres with rights, dedup/family splits, complete turns and positive end markers. Do not admit uncertain scraped/subtitle/synthetic sources merely to increase count.

priorityOrder.topic: GPU-backed foundation and controlled capacity family
priorityOrder.reason: 12m/28m/60m are valid candidates after data and compute budgeting. Current CPU pilot demonstrates operational feasibility but does not train them sufficiently. Profile real GPU memory and tokens/s before purchase or substantial training; no available GPU was demonstrated.

priorityOrder.topic: Structure/tokenizer/context/objective changes only on diagnosed needs
priorityOrder.reason: Keep truthful roles/end protocol. Context256 already retains all histories in the present selfplay, so a context increase would not explain these failures. New RoPE/RMSNorm/SwiGLU or8k/16k tokenizer are candidates, not immediate remedies to underexposure; separate future ablations and byte-equivalent evaluation.

nextExecutableMilestone.status: Proposal only; current pilot cap remains closed
nextExecutableMilestone.choice: Separately preregister a CPU continuation to complete the first admitted TRAIN-window epoch, as a bounded coverage/learning-curve diagnostic; in parallel prepare licensed-modern-prose plus GPU foundation as the main capability program.
nextExecutableMilestone.whyWorthDoing: The current severe underexposure leaves an obvious, measurable uncertainty; first-epoch completion exposes remaining genuine examples rather than repeatedly fitting64examples. Same tokenizer/data/sampler trajectory and fixed-width pair allow a clearer learning-curve observation before scaling or new objectives.
nextExecutableMilestone.notGoal: One epoch is not a sufficiency rule, and even a full epoch gives onlyabout2.823m targets (~0.645/small,~0.251/medium per parameter). Do not call its completion a language result or keep extending merely untilNLL improves.

forecast.method: Linear extrapolation of actual first0.14757epoch receipt times; save/evaluation and sample-length variation add overhead
forecast.caution: No continuation executed. This is not permission to extend current PLAN, buy GPU or launch larger jobs.

nextExecutableMilestone.lrBlocker: core.learning_rate is explicitly bounded by original uniqueUpdates512 and cosine-decays to minLR3e-5. Simply changing total to a full-epoch target atstep513 would restart the cosine near highLR and invalidate same-settings continuation. A new stage must explicitly retain terminalLR3e-5 without warmup/Adam/RNG restart, or predeclare a distinct from-scratch longer-schedule experiment. Do not conceal a LR jump as only extra data exposure.

Current count13878 is not divisible bybatch4; explicitly plan the last partialbatch or describe two repeated windows. Keep both widths exposure-exact and count restart/profile actualoptimizer calls separately within new budget.
nextExecutableMilestone.evaluation: Freeze a terminal coverage milestone and limited interval diagnostics before training; no best-checkpoint choice by exposed language outputs. Report body/end/role losses and full raw content-bearing reply/composite/selfplay evidence. ThisDEV is exposed after this run; preserve sealedTEST and prepare an independently held family evaluation before any promotion.
nextExecutableMilestone.success: New unseen-to-model diagnostic development replies contain appropriate topic-specific information, natural whole output and genuine end markers, not just a reduction in EOS/role/body loss or more identical acknowledgments.
nextExecutableMilestone.stopAndRedirect: If body prediction improves but fixed greedy remains universal acknowledgment, do not grow onlysteps or optimize inference to hide it. Quantify short/generic training mass, context conditional prediction and response-training allocation, then test one justified distribution/objective intervention on a sufficiently trained foundation.

mainCapabilityProgram.notAnAlternativeToDataAudit: Licensing and modern-prose collection should proceed now, but mass training waits for admissible corpus/tokenizer/splits/resources. A CPU first-epoch diagnostic and data preparation are complementary, not a guarantee the existing conversational-only recipe can reach the goal.
mainCapabilityProgram.foundation: Train natural Japanese composition from diverse human prose and whole human dialogue with clear document/turn boundaries and positive ends. Then conversational reply adaptation with retained language exposure, then multi-turn contextual reference training.
mainCapabilityProgram.computeScale: Use actual V3997 counts fromresource-comparison for current plan; own new vocabulary later requiresrecount andfresh tokenizer isolation.16–24GiBGPU is a practical trial target for small/medium models, conditional on measured peaks rather than a purchase authorization.
mainCapabilityProgram.researchPromotion: Require content-bearing unknown-family Japanese dialogue improvements and stable retained language, in addition to legacy gates. No public model/site changes or merge from this pilot.
